messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated gateway 5xx rate from inference-runtime in us-west-2 — impact: increased timeouts and spikes of 502/504. Pager linked to model-serving nodes 3a-3c.

Dana_oncall: seeing it, jumping in. starting timeline.

Bob_runtime: I’ve attached recent gateway logs, CPU on node 3b spiking and kernel messages show repeated SIGSEGV in model_runner.

Alice_sre: can you paste the last kernel oops?

Bob_runtime: ```
[ 1234.567890] infer_runner[14233]: segfault at 0 ip 00007f3a4f8d2c10 sp 00007ffeea12f2a0 error 4 in libattention.so+0x42c10
#0 0x7f3a4f8d2c10 in attention_forward(...)
#1 0x7f3a4f8f1abc in model_step
```

Carlos_infra: nodes 3a/3b/3c are on the same placement group, we had a kernel update last week. No other infra events.

Dana_oncall: current impact: 14% of requests 5xx, p95 latency up 3x. Customers reported timeouts in the last 10m. Emma, FYI for CS.

Emma_cs: acknowledged, I’ll prepare a short note for the most affected customers and flag for potential incident email.

Greg_ml: this looks like an attention op crash — could be kv-cache growth + a JITed kernel bug. Any logs from model runner about memory growth?

Bob_runtime: yes, memory accounted grows right before segfaults. kvcache size jumps to 1.2GB then OOM triggers inside quantized_kernel.

Alice_sre: mitigation proposal: 1) throttle traffic to affected pods, 2) shift traffic to fallback model-v2-safe in other AZs, 3) hotpatch to disable kv-cache autosize.

Dana_oncall: executing step 1 now — applying rate-limit rule to router for tag=model-v3: `ratelimit set model=v3 threshold=120rps`

IncidentBot: Router: updated rate-limit for model=v3 -> 120rps (applied).

Dana_oncall: step 2 — initiating weighted-shift 60% to model-v2-safe in eu-west-1/us-east-1. doing canary traffic first.

Carlos_infra: routing propagation in 30s. Also spinning up warm nodes in other AZs for capacity.

Greg_ml: step 3 patch: rolling config to set `kvcache.max_shard_bytes=256MB` and disable dynamic growth. Bob, can you push the config to runtime?

Bob_runtime: pushing now via config service: `PATCH /runtime/configs/modelrunner` with kv flag. Rolling to 3 nodes.

IncidentBot: Config rollout started: modelrunner/kvcache-limit -> 3 nodes pending.

Alice_sre: while rollout in progress, recommend a rolling restart of node 3b only (recreate container) to capture core on crash and avoid full cluster disruption. Dana, please perform controlled restart.

Dana_oncall: restarting 3b container now: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-runner-3b`

Bob_runtime: after restart, enabling `--generate-core-on-segv` to collect core for offline postmortem.

Dana_oncall: restart success, 3b back in service. initial metrics: 5xx dropped to ~7% and p95 starting to come down.

Emma_cs: letting top affected customers know we’re mitigating; asked for any urgent escalations.

Greg_ml: collected core and `gdb` backtrace shows crash in fused quant attention path when sequence_length > 2048 and kvcache has >1M entries. Points to a boundary check regression.

Bob_runtime: confirmed. Will revert the fused attention patch from last release and cut a hotfix build. ETA 45m for build + deploy to affected pool.

Alice_sre: plan for next 45m: 1) keep throttles; 2) continue traffic shift; 3) deploy hotfix to inference pool as rolling update; 4) monitor closely; 5) prepare postmortem draft.

Dana_oncall: handing off to night shift oncall @bob_runtime in 30m. leaving notes in incident doc: https://internal/redwood/incidents/1818247123

Bob_runtime: taking handoff. I’ll coordinate hotfix and update slack when cutover complete. set alert policy to high for any re-escalation.

Emma_cs: I'll follow up with customers after hotfix deploy and confirm if impact resolved.

IncidentBot: Pager: escalation scheduled. Next update expected in 30m or on resolution. :white_check_mark:
